description: 200 body of GET /items (operationId listItems). One page of LISTED items, newest first. Each card is an item summary: no finder ID, no email, no description, no clipTags. photo is left out for a wallet-id item unless isMine is true. nextToken is opaque and only there when there may be another page; the last page can be empty.

nextToken.description: Opaque. Send it back unchanged as the nextToken query value. Only there when there may be another page.
